name: mtg-tools
description: Improve Commander decklists with mana bases, precon upgrades, budget replacements, deck repairs and bracket reviews.

interface.longDescription: Review Magic: The Gathering Commander decks using Landfiller, Precon Workshop, Budget Swap, Deck Mender and Bracket Shift. Search commanders, build mana bases, suggest precon upgrades, find cheaper replacements, repair missing roles and review bracket changes. Results include estimated prices, tradeoffs, warnings and optional TCGplayer affiliate shopping links. Public tools work without an account. Optional account sync restores private multi-deck plans, collections and priorities across devices and connected MCP clients. Suggestions do not certify deck power or legality, and links do not place orders.
defaultPrompt: Build a 37-land Tatyova mana base under $100.
Review my Commander deck for missing draw, ramp and interaction.
Restore one of my saved multi-deck collection plans and review its missing-card shopping links.

positive.description: Search a commander and build its budget mana base
positive.prompt: Find Tatyova, Benthic Druid, then build 37 lands under $100, bracket 3.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 37 land slots, estimated prices, color coverage, reasoning, and every warning. No saved public build or purchase.

review.commerce_description: Provides optional TCGplayer affiliate shopping links for physical trading cards. No payments, order placement, or account/cart mutation occur through MCP.

publication.release_notes: MTG Tools 2.2.0: nine-tool discovery, card search, public deck URL imports and targeted replacements, collection-aware mana builds, safe validation guidance, versioned public benchmark coverage, observed reliability and optional first-party shopping-link measurement. Direct affiliate links remain available; no purchases or public saves.
